state.premature_release: Label alpha is reserved for edition E with token T. Edition E has no event. E creation is delayed. The system releases alpha because a request timed out. Edition F reserves alpha with token U. The delayed creation of E then commits using T because E stream was empty and nothing fenced it.
state.empty_fence: An empty edition E stream receives a durable creation-fence event at expected physical position 0. A previously paused creation command later tries to append its first event at expected position 0. All writers use the expected position and honor the fence after reloading.
state.no_event: An empty edition E stream receives an empty append at position 0; the event store returns without writing anything. A paused first creation still expects position 0.
state.rename_race: Draft edition E has confirmed alpha. Its stream atomically records rename intent R from alpha to beta; while R is unresolved, publication is rejected. Beta reservation, the rename, and confirmation are pending. A publication request arrives.
state.late_reservation: Rename intent R is cancelled by a durable target-side fence. A delayed worker had already read R and later reserves beta in the beta claim stream. A reactor saw cancellation before beta was reserved and will not run again; no process inspects later beta reservation or reconciles this operation.
state.release_generation: Claim alpha previously held by edition E token G1 was released. Later E reserves alpha with token G2. A duplicate delayed release message names E and G1. The claim compares the full current holder and generation.
state.exact_retry: An operation token T reserved alpha for edition E and later completed and released that exact reservation. A new operation token U currently holds alpha for edition F. The original request with T and unchanged intent is retried; current holder U remains active.
state.rename_done: Edition E had a confirmed alpha reservation under token A. It reserved beta under B, committed an E rename fact naming A and B, and confirmed B. The alpha claim receives that exact committed rename fact as proof, and its current holder still matches E and A.
state.changed_intent: Token R first requested edition E rename from alpha to beta. A later request reuses R for E rename from alpha to gamma.
state.publication_wins: Edition E is draft and has no pending rename. A publication event appends first. A competing rename begin used the preceding expected version, gets a conflict, reloads, and rejects because published editions cannot rename.
state.actor_stale: A user is authorized when starting a rename. They are then revoked before the edition accepts the rename; the only check was the earlier user-permission read. The business rule requires authorization at the actual edition acceptance.
state.scope: One claim stream per normalized edition label has one current holder or reservation. The edition has one pending rename at a time. The claim records only reservation, confirmation, release and exact retry evidence for that label, and does not store a list of criteria.

premature_double.instructions: In premature_release, do two editions end up accepted or holding alpha?

empty_fence_blocks.instructions: In empty_fence, does the stale creation append at position 0 succeed?

empty_append_blocks.instructions: In no_event, did the empty append prevent the paused creation?

rename_publication.instructions: In rename_race, may the arriving publication be accepted while R is unresolved?

late_leaks.instructions: In late_reservation, can beta remain reserved despite the cancelled rename?

late_release_new.instructions: In release_generation, does G1 release the current G2 reservation?

retry_steals.instructions: In exact_retry, must the old T retry reacquire alpha from edition F?

rename_release.instructions: In rename_done, does the exact committed rename prove edition E switched away from alpha token A?

changed_is_retry.instructions: In changed_intent, is the second request an exact retry?

published_rename.instructions: In publication_wins, can the competing stale rename begin be accepted after the published event?

actor_check_suffices.instructions: In actor_stale, does the early permission check prove the business authorization rule was met at acceptance?

scope_children.instructions: In scope, does the label claim require an aggregate-owned list of the edition criteria?
